description: Cartographie des stations d'épuration is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur. Here you will find the location of the wastewater treatment plants of the Nice Cote d’Azur Metropolis on a cadastral scale. Coverage: Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur. The portal shows the English title as "Mapping of sewage treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur. Its keywords include step, assainissement, station, epuration. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV, JSON, SHP, KMZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
